dispatch_evidence.verdict_quote: A/B scenario test: OLD (pre-fix) script E|-injection forgery => rc=0, forged section rendered ('62:### OD-999 — FORGED ENTRY'); NEW (fixed) script same register => '[gen-directives-view] ERROR: entry OD-500 field elaboration.intent contains CR/LF — refusing to render (delimiter-injection guard)', 'render failed (rc=4) — left untouched'. Self-tests: gen-directives-view 10/10, directives-register-lib 47/47, dispatch-directives 13/13 on BOTH node and jq engines. --check GREEN and byte-identical on the real 24-entry register on both engines. dr_validate rc=0 on the real register (no dispatch over-fire). Independent fixtures: pipe-in-intent renders literally with reviewed_by=pending-operator intact (no forged APPROVED); newline/CR/pipe in title/instruction/requirements/supersedes all hard-error rc=4 with named field, committed doc UNCHANGED. node vs jq render byte-identical (same md5).
dispatch_evidence.findings_summary: PASS — Mechanism-class fix, no Critical/Major. The delimiter-injection Critical is closed: forgery reproduced on pre-fix code (rc=0, forged '### OD-999 ... Status: BINDING' section via newline-injected E| record) and blocked on fixed code (rc=4, doc untouched). Fix is sound on two axes: (1) per-scalar trailing-remainder M records + start-anchored index()==1 prefix parse means embedded '|' renders literally and cannot shift into the reviewed_by position; (2) CR/LF rejected in every value before any emit, killing newline record-forgery. Guard validates before emit; --gen writes via tempfile so a rejected register never truncates the public doc; run_check errors (rc2) not false GREEN/RED. All 8-field E-line consumers updated in-repo; PIPESTATUS correctly returns jq rc after tr -d CR pipes. dr_validate now HAS a caller (dispatch-directives.sh run(), self-test S10). FP rate low: real 24-entry register all clean, dr_validate rc=0 on it, banned chars are already-broken in positional/case-glob consumers. Two MINOR advisories (non-blocking): (a) gen-view allows '|' in surfaces (trailing-remainder-safe) while dr_validate bans it (dr__stream parses S positionally) — intentional per-consumer scoping, dispatch fail-closed, but one register file has two validity verdicts; (b) jq vs node reject-message wording differs slightly for pipe-in-embedded-field (both rc=4, both name the field). One HYPOTHESIZED out-of-scope residual: dispatch-directives.sh's OWN runtime invocation is orchestrator-doctrine-driven, not hook-enforced — pre-existing, not worsened here.
